title: ee.attest.v1
description: Response payload for `ee attest memory|pack|query --json` (bd-1n0np.22.4). The ee.response.v2 envelope wraps an ee.attest.v1 payload that surfaces a redaction-safe provenance attestation: a blake3 bundleHash over the canonical AttestationBundle (ee.attestation.bundle.v1, bd-1n0np.22.1) plus the subject, the redaction posture, and the local trust statement. The attestation attests LOCAL ee evidence custody and hash consistency — NOT objective truth. Deterministic: the same subject and database reproduce the identical bundleHash.

bundleHash.description: blake3 hash over the exact public redaction-safe AttestationBundle emitted in data.bundle. Deterministic for a fixed subject + database; this is the single value support-bundle/handoff/why should embed (bd-1n0np.22.3) so all surfaces share one chain-of-custody object.

subjectId.description: Canonical public memory/pack ID or a domain-separated blake3 identity for non-ID subjects. Raw query text is never emitted.

rawTextIncluded.description: Whether raw subject text is embedded. Default false (hash-only / redaction-safe); null for hash-only query subjects that carry no raw text.

objectiveTruthAttested.description: Always false/null: the bundle attests local custody + hash consistency, never objective truth.

trustStatement.description: Human-readable scope of what the attestation does and does not claim.

bundle.description: The canonical AttestationBundle internal manifest (schema ee.attestation.bundle.v1): subject, evidenceManifest, redactionManifest, hashManifest, omissions, trustStatement. See src/models/attestation.rs.

evidenceManifest.description: Hash-referenced evidence the bundle covers. IDs are public aliases or domain hashes, provenanceUri is omitted, and noncanonical hashes are omitted explicitly.

redactionManifest.description: What was redacted and why — redaction is recorded, never silent.

hashManifest.description: Per-entry blake3 hashes that compose the bundleHash.
